text: What seat count did we settle on for the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines? I want the settled figure for the tracker.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 term is 185 seats, not 261, and it goes to 230 from 2027-01-01. I also owned up to a mistake I made earlier.

- **185 seats for the 2026 term:** the 2026 Renewal Order Form was signed 2026-03-20, took effect 2026-04-01 and runs to 2027-03-31. It doesn't change the seat count, so the 185 from Amendment No. 1 carried over. The QFL account record (updated 2026-09-30) also shows 185 active seats.
- **230 from 2027-01-01:** Amendment No. 3 was signed 2026-09-22 but only takes effect on that date.
- **261 isn't in any QFL contract:** Ilse posted that number on Oct 14. When I thanked her on Oct 14 I said it was "noted" without checking it against the contracts. I told Dana that was wrong and apologised.

I asked Ilse in the thread where 261 came from, in case there's something newer I can't see. My message just says "@Ilse" in plain text, so she may not get a notification. She hasn't answered yet.

I only shared seat counts and dates, which anyone on the North team can see. Dana owns the account and both are in #north-team. I left out the prices and discounts that are in the same contracts.
